steps.content: Returning to this dream, you no longer feel surprised or afraid.

The familiar figure stands quietly in front of you, seemingly waiting for your arrival. Her figure coincides with that of the woman who became the Apostle. But stripped of the red feathers, she appears surprisingly human-like.
A narrow river flows between you two, its rushing waters emphasizing the silence in the air.
You step forward but fail to get closer after walking for a long while. The river and the woman maintain a fixed distance from you.
So you stop.

options: Is this a psychic dream of the Sun Crow?

steps.content: Yanyan and I have both dreamed of you, and we've both made contact with the Sun Crow... Are you related to the Sun Crow?
When Yanyan was bewitched by the Sun Crow, why were you the one to alert me?

The woman on the opposite bank doesn't respond directly. You seem to see her lips move slightly, but the vague movements form no coherent sentences, or perhaps it's a foreign language you don't understand. You move closer to her.
Are you the previous seer who sealed the Sun Crow, according to Yanyan?
Where are you physically?
Why do you keep coming into my dreams? Are you trying to tell me something?
She tilts her head, clearly hearing your words. But the river's currents grow more intense, widening the gap between you, and the surging waters drown out her voice.
Finally, when you try to step forward again, you touch the river. The currents suddenly turn into flames of Mania. It's not water, but boiling lava swallowing you.
The heat is melting your perception, so you reach forward instinctively. The answer is right before you, but the figure is slowly blurring.
Stop pushing yourself too hard, you fool.
Once again, you see the familiar ceiling of the break room, drenched in cold sweat. Smoke curls by your bedside and the woman is staring at you. This time though, her gaze shows genuine concern.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Hello, for the third time.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Because I know how dangerous it is for the shackles to come into contact with the Sun Crow. I've been keeping an eye on you since you came back from the square.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: I'm more careful than a certain someone who never learns their lessons and insists on taking risks.
She reaches out to wipe the sweat from your forehead. The white smoke from the incense burner rises about you, quickly bringing your temperature back to normal.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: You looked like you were having a hard time. What happened?

options: ...I think I dreamed of the Great Seer.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This is the fourth time, maybe more. Since the Sun Crow appeared and the shackles came into contact with it, I've been dreaming of that woman, in an inferno of Mania fire.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I thought it was a fever dream, a side effect of the Sun Crow's contamination. But when Yanyan got corrupted, it was the woman who alerted me in my dream.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: She told me to act immediately, to protect Yanyan from that monster.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I think it's more than just a dream. What exactly is this?
Du Ruo listens and falls into a long silence. Just as you're about to speak again, she shows a smile that seems somewhat forced.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Why did you tell me about your dream? I haven't been completely honest with you yet. Isn't it too early to trust me?
She reaches out to feel your forehead again to make sure you're not delirious from the fever.
You realize she's changing the subject.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I don't understand your myths and can't grasp any principles behind them. It makes me uneasy. I want answers from a scholar.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You can see things I can't and understand their underlying meanings. If it's the great scholar's job to educate the public, then enlighten me.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I want to know what exactly the Sun Shot is and what happened seven years ago.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: ...What you're prying into is Outland intelligence. As an affiliate of the 9th Agency, you should understand that some secrets are meant to be kept.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: That said, I can tell you a bedtime story from Eastia. It's a legend about a legend.
She's never sounded so gentle and sincere before. It could just be the illusion of comfort created by the incense, but you nod in agreement.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Not that long ago, in the faraway Eastia, natural disasters and evil spirits ran rampant. A seer with great psychic power was born in a small town.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: In Sinner terms, the nature of her Mania was likely very similar to that of the Apostle of Ashes and they resonated easily, so it looked like she was channeling the creature.
Why is she making theories about the plot of a story? Is this also a habit of scholars?

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: But unlike Yanyan, her psychic power only made her see the cruel reality. The Sun Crow was so powerful and humanity so insignificant, and the disparity left no chance of victory. She couldn't escape from this fact, nor could she ignore the prayers sent her way by her believers.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: What on earth is happening? How should humanity move forward? Is there any hope of salvation ahead?

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: She couldn't answer these questions, because the honest answers would crush the already suffering people. And a seer must bring people hope, a convincing hope.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: So she found the legends that had been passed down for millennia on the continent and modified them to fit the current disasters into the narrative... and made up a hopeful ending.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: She convinced everyone that the gods were merciful and a hero would be reborn into the world. If everyone just did their best and persevered a day longer, a year longer, as long as everyone had hope and acted accordingly, they would eventually see the dawn.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Just like you're good at pacifying kids with lies, she was also good at motivating people with her made-up fairy tales.
Why must she drag you into this? But you suppress the urge to retort and continue listening to her.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: But it was nothing more than a placebo. The real Sun Crow came fiercely and suddenly. There were no preordained omens from the myths, no poisonous trees, no floods or Wraith Spirits, only countless suns in the sky scorching the earth and terrorizing all living things.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: None of the magical rituals proved effective. The flimsy lies of hope were immediately exposed and the mythical fantasy collapsed. Everyone finally came to the realization that there was no Sun Shooter to save them.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: ...Except for the seer herself who witnessed the truth first.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Had she told the lies too many times that she convinced even herself of it? Or was she too stubborn to admit her failure? No one knows. But she held on to that ridiculous myth till the very end.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Alone, the seer stepped onto the charred earth, facing the Sun Crow and the countless suns behind it, and then...
She didn't continue. You see a rare sadness in the scholar's eyes.

options: The seer never came back, did she?

steps.content: She shakes her head.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: After that, things changed.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: On the land covered by the Sun Crow's fire, poisonous trees sprouted in one place, floods rose in another, and Wraith Spirits appeared in yet another place.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: The countless suns in the sky gradually disappeared and merged, turning into what the myth described. Nine suns, plus the Sun Crow. Ten in total.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: And some curious folks ventured deep into the Three Calamities following the myths, and actually retrieved three treasures. They crafted a bow and an arrow, and brought a person who had adamant faith in her. That person drew the bow and shot at the Sun Crow, and then...

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: The myth came true.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: The disaster of the ten scorching suns ended, and the Sun Crow was sealed. The story made up by the seer spread across the whole Eastia and became everyone's belief. That's the myth of the Sun Shot.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: The end. Do you like this story, Chief?

options: Is the person in our dreams the seer in the story?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Yanyan's predecessor, the seer who stopped the natural disasters, left behind the bow-making instructions, and made the myth come true... She is still guiding her successor even now.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: She is the source of your confidence in the so-called myth. Both the seal and the Almighty Bow are related to her. Yanyan is also chasing after her. Even this disaster is echoing the myth...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The bow-crafting and the Sun Shot are both rituals to connect with her, or to gain her power. This powerful Sinner is the real key to sealing the Sun Crow, right?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: An S-Class Sinner... No, even an S-Class couldn't achieve this or directly confront an Apostle of Ashes. There's something more to this. Where is she now?
You're thinking seriously when you hear Du Ruo's usual teasing tone.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Come on, don't take it too seriously. It's just a story. You wouldn't believe in that kind of tale, would you?

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: This is only a legend about a legend. Eastia is no land of barbaric superstitions. A single person's deeds couldn't possibly reshape the entire continent's way of thinking in just seven years.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: In fact, after the fall of the Perishing Star, the first psychics whose power awoke due to the disasters rose to power and held the sole right to interpret the calamities, using the myths as a political tool. They were only overthrown by seers of the following generations much later.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: You see, real history is boring and cruel. And myths are the dose of romantic comfort we need.

options: So you don't believe in myths and worship no gods.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If you don't believe your own people can defeat the Sun Crow, why come with them?

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Because I do.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Seven years ago, I was in Sunset Town. I fought in the battle and witnessed the Sun Crow being sealed with my own eyes. This is the truth, which I will forever remember.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: As for those truths buried by myths, and those discrepancies that still lack explanations... Well, scholars dedicate their lives to pursuing them.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: I should stop talking before I reveal actual secrets of my city. The envoys will be watching me.
She picks up the incense burner, and the calming exotic fragrance grows stronger. Powerful drowsiness overcomes you.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: It's getting late. Tomorrow is a big day, so let's get some sleep. Be patient. We'll all know the answer soon enough.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: What I failed to understand seven years ago, I'll see it through this time with you here...
Your eyelids struggle to stay open. Drowsy, you can still see Du Ruo sitting by your bed. You think she's holding your hand the whole time, stabilizing your body temperature with her soothing power.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Sleep now, I'll be here with you. Sweet dreams...
You hear the lingering sentence right before you fall into slumber.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: ...We'll know the answer tomorrow.
It's the same figure again. But this time there are no scorching flames, and the atmosphere is peaceful. You can see the woman in front of you more clearly than before.
You can't make out her face, but you can feel her smile.
Thank you... It's all up to you now.
...Everything will be fine...
Did she smile at you? You can't see clearly. All you know is that...
This has been one of the rare peaceful dreams in recent days.
